name: 1T-LSD
summary: 1T-LSD, also known as 1-(thiophene-2-carbonyl)-LSD or as SYN-L-021, is an acylated derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD), which has been sold as a designer drug. It was first identified in Japan in 2023 on blotter paper misrepresented as containing 1D-LSD, but which on analysis was determined to contain 1T-LSD instead. It was also detected in Germany around the same time.

uses.text: 1T-LSD, also known as 1-(thiophene-2-carbonyl)-LSD or as SYN-L-021, is an acylated derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD), which has been sold as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 1T-LSD（N1-(噻吩-2-羰基)-麥角酸二乙醯胺，SYN-L-021）是一種麥角酸二乙醯胺的醯基化產物，以策劃藥的形式銷售。它最初於2023年在日本首次被發現，當時吸墨紙上被誤認為含有1D-LSD，研究者認為1D-LSD難以合成而產生了懷疑，經分析後發現，它實際上含有的是1T-LSD。

pharmacology.en: Like other LSD derivatives with a group added on the indole nitrogen, it is thought to be a prodrug that the body turns into LSD, which then acts on the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他在吲哚氮上加了基團的LSD衍生物一樣，它被認為是前驅藥，身體會把它轉化為LSD，再作用於血清素5-HT2A受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他在吲哚氮上加了基团的LSD衍生物一样，它被认为是前驱药，身体会把它转化为LSD，再作用于血清素5-HT2A受体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It was first found in Japan in 2023 on blotter paper sold as 1D-LSD. Its thiophene group is a five membered ring containing a sulfur atom.
fact.zh: 它於2023年在日本首次被發現，出現在標示為1D-LSD的吸墨紙上。它的噻吩基是一個含有硫原子的五元環。
fact.zhHans: 它于2023年在日本首次被发现，出现在标示为1D-LSD的吸墨纸上。它的噻吩基是一个含有硫原子的五元环。
